description: Ministry of Lands - Appoint acquiring Officer, Rambukkana D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette notification is primarily about land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an Acquiring Officer under the Land Acquisition Act for the Central Highway Project Phase III. The core content deals with property acquisition for public projects, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters. While it mentions a government minister and includes an appointment, the primary focus is on land acquisition procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
